# prometheus

Prometheus and its CRDs, as the cluster's metrics store.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| alertmanager | boolean | `false` | Run Alertmanager beside Prometheus. |
| chart | string | `upstream.chart` | Store path of the kube-prometheus-stack Helm chart. Required. |
| crds | string | `upstream.crds` | Store path of the stripped-down CRD manifest. Required.  Separate from the chart because the operator's own release pins a different CRD version than the chart bundles, and because a chart that installs CRDs re-applies them on every upgrade.  |
| kubeStateMetrics | boolean | `false` | Run kube-state-metrics. |
| namespace | string | `"monitoring"` | Namespace the operator and the Prometheus run in. |
| nodeExporter | boolean | `false` | Run node-exporter as a DaemonSet. |
| retention | string | `"7d"` | How long samples are kept. |
| storage | string | `"10Gi"` | Size of the Prometheus volume claim. |
| storageClass | null or string | `null` | Storage class for that claim. Null takes the cluster's default. |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | [KUBERNETES_CLUSTER](../signatures/KUBERNETES_CLUSTER.md) | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| issuance | [X509_ISSUANCE](../signatures/X509_ISSUANCE.md) | Something that signs certificates, and whether a browser will trust what it signs. |
| storageClass | [STORAGE_CLASS](../signatures/STORAGE_CLASS.md) | A StorageClass a PVC can name, and whether it is the cluster's default. |
| webhook | [X509_WEBHOOK](../signatures/X509_WEBHOOK.md) | The certificate controller's admission webhook is serving, so its CRs are accepted. |
